self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Golden Majesty (R1): scoring hits on opponents increases ATK by 4% for 8s, up to 5 stacks (ATK +20% at max). While protected by a shield this bonus is doubled (ATK +40% at max stacks). Shield Strength +20% not modeled (non-combat). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
